## What you did
- Moved the CSV export to a background streaming job (PR #430), resolving timeouts for large datasets and gaining approval from Daniel Levi [2][5].
- Advanced Dashboards v2 (PR #427) by introducing a compact widget header, a simplified menu, a retention chart loading skeleton, and a cohort categorical palette [1][3][7].

## What changed
- Priya Shah blocked the Orbitly v2 rollout because the CSV export is absent from the v2 widget menu, and Rachel Kim reported that Zest is urgently seeking an export ETA for their Monday review [6][9][10].
- A Sentry error was logged on staging due to a tooltip crash on empty cohort rows within the retention chart [8].

## What is still open
- Restore the CSV export feature into the v2 widget menu to unblock the Orbitly rollout scheduled for Thursday [10].
- Fix the tooltip crash on empty cohorts in `RetentionChart.tsx` on staging [1][8].
- Merge PR #430 once CI is green [5] and prepare PR #427 for the Wednesday staging milestone [3][7].
